source: Background names, origins, unique markers, attribute increases, and starting coins come from Black Sword Hack - Ultimate Chaos Edition SRD v1.0.2, Character Creation. Feature lines paraphrase the SRD for tool use; consult the SRD for the authoritative wording.
weapon_tables_note: The nine entries per origin are the SRD's own starting-weapon tables, transcribed on August 4, 2026 in the source's die order, so entry N is the result of N. A d10 result of 10 exceeds the table and yields no weapon, matching the SRD's empty entry. The '(two-handed)' suffix carries the SRD's asterisk. It is descriptive text the narrator reads: combat_attack takes two_handed as its own boolean argument and parses no weapon name.

backgrounds.name: Berserker
backgrounds.feature: Enter a rage that adds a d6 to damage dealt and halves damage received; the rage ends on a d6 result of 1.

backgrounds.name: Chieftain
backgrounds.feature: Use STR in place of CHA when intimidating.

backgrounds.name: Herbalist
backgrounds.feature: Create d6 doses of healing balm, hallucinogenic drugs, or poison; a long rest close to nature replenishes the stock.

backgrounds.name: Hunter
backgrounds.feature: The first arrow of a fight always hits and adds the character's level to damage.

backgrounds.name: Raider
backgrounds.feature: Critical hits deal damage equal to the STR score.

backgrounds.name: Scout
backgrounds.feature: Advantage on initiative tests.

backgrounds.name: Shaman
backgrounds.feature: Hold pacts with two spirits.

backgrounds.name: Storyteller
backgrounds.feature: Know d4 useful facts each session and distract an audience while telling a story.

backgrounds.name: Survivor
backgrounds.feature: Find an improvised weapon within d6 minutes anywhere.

backgrounds.name: Wildling
backgrounds.feature: Take a long rest anywhere without penalty.

backgrounds.name: Bodyguard
backgrounds.feature: Protect a nearby character and absorb half of the damage aimed at them.

backgrounds.name: Bookworm
backgrounds.feature: Substitute INT for any other attribute on one test per long rest.

backgrounds.name: Diplomat
backgrounds.feature: Speak two extra languages and act first when only talking during combat.

backgrounds.name: Inventor
backgrounds.feature: Build two scientific marvels.

backgrounds.name: Legionnaire
backgrounds.feature: Let nearby allies reroll a failed dodge, parry, or attack three times per session.

backgrounds.name: Sophist
backgrounds.feature: Make one listener believe an obvious lie for one hour, once per session.

backgrounds.name: Street urchin
backgrounds.feature: Advantage on stealth, pickpocketing, eavesdropping, and streetwise tests.

backgrounds.name: Surgeon
backgrounds.feature: A successful INT test reduces an ally's Helpless die from d6 to d4.

backgrounds.name: Sword master
backgrounds.feature: Use DEX in place of STR with one-handed bladed weapons.

backgrounds.name: Assassin
backgrounds.feature: The first attack against an unaware target deals damage equal to the DEX score.

backgrounds.name: Changeling
backgrounds.feature: Hold two faerie ties.

backgrounds.name: Forbidden knowledge
backgrounds.feature: Begin play with four randomly selected spells.

backgrounds.name: Pit-fighter
backgrounds.feature: Unarmed damage equals weapon damage.

backgrounds.name: Snake blood
backgrounds.feature: Immune to poison and venom.

backgrounds.name: Vicious
backgrounds.feature: Weapon damage rises to d8 and unarmed damage rises to d6.

backgrounds.name: Warlock
backgrounds.feature: Hold pacts with two demons.
